result.topic_en: Riemann's draft notes on electrodynamics: he defines the electric tension (potential) as 1/(4π) times an integral of the charge density divided by distance, states the Poisson equation, and discusses electromotive force and its causes in terms of positive and negative electricity.

methods.what: Electric tension/potential defined as 1/(4π) times the volume integral of charge density over distance

methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z^2}=-\varrho$

methods.what: Electromotive force component as the sum of the potential gradient and a density-gradient term

items.quote:
Es ist dann, um der Grösse $\varrho$ eine reelle Bedeutung zu geben,
nicht nöthig zweierlei Electricitäten anzunehmen
items.english: It is then not necessary, in order to give the quantity ρ a real meaning, to assume two kinds of electricity.

items.quote:
sondern man
kann im Wesentlichen zu der Franklin'schen[?] Auffassung der
electrischen Erscheinungen zurückkehren, ohne irgend[?] eine

items.english: Rather, one can essentially return to the Franklinian conception of electrical phenomena, without any striking assumption.
